item.title: Send a Picnic Shopping Text
item.audience: a friend who is going to the shop
item.prompt_text: You and your friend Ivo are having a picnic. Ask Ivo to buy four apples and a small bottle of water. You already have sandwiches. Tell Ivo that the shopping money is in the cup by the door.
item.target_grammar: Simple requests with can you; numbers and place phrases.
item.target_structure: Greet Ivo, give the shopping list, say what you already have, and say where the money is.

checklist.point: Ask for four apples and a small bottle of water.
Say where Ivo can find the money.
